summary: Tested Tax Exempt module end-to-end: backend endpoints (upload-cert, PUT lead/customer, GET /me), Admin Lead drawer 'Tax Exempt' tab with drag/drop upload + view/print/download, Admin Customer Dashboard 'Tax Exempt' tab, and Quote Builder tax-exempt toggle + preview 'Sales Tax (Exempt)' line. Current environment has tax_enabled=false and tax_rates=[]; live-computed sales tax percentage on quote couldn't be visually verified (label toggle to '(Exempt)' works). Consider configuring a tax rate in this env for future full end-to-end verification.
critical_code_review_comments: tax_exempt.py – Solid: separation of concerns, MIME/size validation, dedupe via UUID filenames, get_tax_exempt_state falls back to email if user_id missing.

TaxExemptCard.jsx re-renders reset local edits via useEffect on [entityId, initialExempt, initialInfo] — if parent re-passes a new object identity each render, user edits could be reset. Consider deep comparison or using entityId only.
Quote page reads /api/admin-settings/tax; if tax_rates empty and tax_enabled=false, subtotal x rate = 0 — behavior is consistent, no bug.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — Lead 'Test Opportunity' and Customer 'Test Customer' were used and reset to non-exempt after each test.
